facts.note: Girard refuses to show Monnier his watch at dinner ("I would not show it to him"). After dinner he sits alone in the dining room with brandy, hears the temple strike ten there, and says he did not look at his watch.
"I went out at twenty-one minutes past ten by my watch, and I stayed under the front windows of the house."
"The piano started up in the salon just as I lit my cigar, at twenty-nine minutes past ten by my watch."
"At twenty-six minutes to eleven by my watch I heard faint quick bells from the master's window up above." Same reading (10:34) and same source.
Returns at fourteen minutes to eleven by his watch; hall clock had just struck eleven and its face showed two minutes past eleven; went straight up to Félix in the library.
